Volumetric Shadowing via Shadow Map Ray Marching
definition: A ray marching algorithm that computes volume illumination by integrating light along a ray, using an opacity shadow map to determine occlusion by the volume itself.
summary: Ray Marching with Shadow Mapping computes self-shadowing in participating media by sampling precomputed transmittance from a 3D texture, avoiding secondary ray marches and differing from shadow volume rendering by using a texture stack instead of a geometric volume.
